parameters.name: AutoRenew
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal.

- true: enables auto-renewal.
- false: does not enable auto-renewal.

Default value: false.

parameters.name: AutoRenewPeriod
parameters.description:
The auto-renewal period, in months. This parameter takes effect only when AutoRenew is set to true.

<props="intl">Valid values: 12 and 36. Default value: 12.</props>

<props="china">

- If PeriodUnit is set to Month, valid values are 1, 12, 36, and 60. Default value: 1.

- If PeriodUnit is set to Year, valid values are 12, 36, and 60. Default value: 12.

</props>

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The **ClientToken** value can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](~~25693~~).

parameters.name: Period
parameters.description:
The duration of the reserved instance.

<props="intl">Valid values: 1 and 3.</props>


<props="china">

- If PeriodUnit is set to Year, valid values are 1, 3, and 5.

- If PeriodUnit is set to Month, the valid value is 1.

</props>


Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PeriodUnit
parameters.description:
The unit of the duration of the reserved instance.

<props="intl">Valid values: Year.</props>

<props="intl">Default value: Year.</props>

<props="china">Valid values: Year and Month.</props>

<props="china">Default value: Month.</props>

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the reserved instance.

You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.
